_meta.description: World philosophy — schools of thought, key thinkers, and core concepts

core_ideas: Virtue is the only true good
stoicism.modern_relevance: CBT therapy, resilience practices, leadership philosophy

description.en: Founded by Zeno of Citium (~300 BCE), Stoicism teaches that virtue alone is sufficient for happiness. The Stoics distinguished what is 'up to us' (our judgments, desires, actions) from what is not. Their emphasis on reason, resilience, and acceptance remains influential in modern psychology and leadership.
description.ko: 키티온의 제논(기원전 ~300년)에 의해 창설된 스토아 철학은 덕만이 행복을 위한 충분 조건이라고 가르칩니다. 스토아 철학자들은 '우리에게 달린 것'(판단, 욕구, 행동)과 그렇지 않은 것을 구별했습니다.

core_ideas: Absence of pain and anxiety as pleasure
Friendship as greatest source of pleasure
Atoms and void as basis of reality
epicureanism.modern_relevance: Happiness science, hedonism studies, secular humanism

description.en: Epicurus (341–270 BCE) held that pleasure (specifically tranquility and freedom from pain) is the highest good. He advocated withdrawal from public life to cultivate friendship and simple pleasures. Often misunderstood as hedonism, Epicureanism actually emphasizes intellectual pleasure over sensual indulgence.
description.ko: 에피쿠로스(기원전 341–270년)는 쾌락(특히 평온함과 고통으로부터의 자유)이 최고의 선이라고 주장했습니다. 그는 공적 삶을 멀리하고 우정과 소박한 즐거움을 추구하도록 권했습니다.

existentialism.modern_relevance: Psychotherapy (existential therapy), literature, personal autonomy ethics

description.en: Existentialism holds that human beings first exist, then define their own essence through choices. Jean-Paul Sartre's maxim 'existence precedes essence' captures this. Existentialists emphasize radical freedom, responsibility, and the challenge of creating meaning in an indifferent universe.
description.ko: 실존주의는 인간이 먼저 존재하고, 그 다음 선택을 통해 자신의 본질을 정의한다고 주장합니다. 장폴 사르트르의 '실존은 본질에 앞선다'는 격언이 이를 잘 표현합니다.

core_ideas: Truth as what works in practice
pragmatism.modern_relevance: American democracy, education reform, business strategy

description.en: An American philosophical tradition founded by C.S. Peirce, pragmatism holds that the meaning and truth of ideas lie in their practical consequences. William James and John Dewey expanded it into a philosophy of action, emphasizing problem-solving and democratic participation.
description.ko: C.S. 퍼스가 창설한 미국 철학 전통인 프래그머티즘은 아이디어의 의미와 진실이 실용적 결과에 있다고 주장합니다. 윌리엄 제임스와 존 듀이는 이를 행동 철학으로 확장했습니다.

core_ideas: Greatest happiness for the greatest number
utilitarianism.modern_relevance: Policy making, AI ethics, animal rights, effective altruism

description.en: Founded by Jeremy Bentham and refined by John Stuart Mill, utilitarianism judges actions by their consequences — specifically the happiness or suffering produced. Its influence is vast, shaping modern economics, policy, and contemporary effective altruism movements.
description.ko: 제레미 벤담이 창시하고 존 스튜어트 밀이 정교화한 공리주의는 행동을 그 결과, 특히 생산되는 행복이나 고통으로 판단합니다.

core_ideas: Categorical Imperative: act only by maxims you could universalize
Treat persons as ends, never merely as means
Rational autonomy as basis of morality
Good will as only unconditional good
kantian_ethics.modern_relevance: Human rights law, medical ethics, AI ethics

description.en: Immanuel Kant (1724–1804) argued that morality is grounded in reason, not consequences. His Categorical Imperative demands that we act only on principles we could will to be universal laws. Human dignity — treating people as ends in themselves — is foundational.
description.ko: 임마누엘 칸트(1724–1804)는 도덕이 결과가 아닌 이성에 근거한다고 주장했습니다. 그의 정언명령은 보편적 법칙으로 원할 수 있는 원칙에 따라서만 행동하도록 요구합니다.

virtue_ethics.modern_relevance: Character education, positive psychology, leadership ethics

description.en: Originating with Aristotle, virtue ethics focuses on character development rather than rules or outcomes. A virtuous person — courageous, just, generous, temperate — will naturally act well. Revived by Alasdair MacIntyre and others in the 20th century as a challenge to both Kantian and utilitarian ethics.
description.ko: 아리스토텔레스로부터 시작된 덕 윤리학은 규칙이나 결과보다 성품 발달에 초점을 맞춥니다. 덕스러운 사람 — 용감하고, 정의롭고, 관대하고, 절제하는 — 은 자연스럽게 올바르게 행동할 것입니다.

phenomenology.modern_relevance: Psychology, cognitive science, UX design, nursing and medicine

description.en: Founded by Edmund Husserl, phenomenology studies the structure of experience and consciousness. Rather than explaining phenomena scientifically, it asks what things are as they appear to consciousness. Heidegger and Merleau-Ponty expanded it to include embodiment and being-in-the-world.
description.ko: 에드문트 후설이 창시한 현상학은 경험과 의식의 구조를 연구합니다. 현상을 과학적으로 설명하는 대신, 의식에 나타나는 그대로의 사물이 무엇인지를 묻습니다.

core_ideas: Clarity of language as philosophical goal
analytic_philosophy.modern_relevance: Philosophy of mind, AI, linguistics, formal logic

description.en: Emerging from Frege, Russell, and Wittgenstein's work on logic and language, analytic philosophy dominated 20th century English-speaking philosophy. It emphasizes precision, argument, and the relationship between language and reality. Today it encompasses philosophy of mind, language, science, and formal ethics.
description.ko: 프레게, 러셀, 비트겐슈타인의 논리와 언어 연구에서 비롯된 분석 철학은 20세기 영어권 철학을 지배했습니다. 정밀성, 논증, 언어와 현실 사이의 관계를 강조합니다.

core_ideas: Historical materialism: history driven by material/economic conditions
Class struggle as engine of history
marxism.modern_relevance: Critical theory, sociology, political economy, labor rights

description.en: Developed by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels, Marxism analyzes history and society through the lens of economic relations and class struggle. It argues that capitalism produces alienation and exploitation, and that revolutionary change will lead to a classless society.
description.ko: 칼 마르크스와 프리드리히 엥겔스가 발전시킨 마르크스주의는 경제적 관계와 계급 투쟁의 관점에서 역사와 사회를 분석합니다.

confucian_philosophy.modern_relevance: East Asian governance, education, family values, corporate culture

description.en: Confucius (551–479 BCE) developed an ethical philosophy centered on human relationships, virtue, and proper governance. His ideal of the junzi (gentleman-scholar) who cultivates virtue and serves society shaped East Asian civilizations more than any other thinker.
description.ko: 공자(기원전 551–479년)는 인간 관계, 덕, 올바른 통치를 중심으로 한 윤리 철학을 발전시켰습니다. 덕을 함양하고 사회에 봉사하는 군자(君子) 이상은 다른 어떤 사상가보다 동아시아 문명을 형성했습니다.

core_ideas: Tao as ineffable source of all
taoist_philosophy.modern_relevance: Flow psychology, systems thinking, environmental ethics, martial arts

description.en: Laozi's Tao Te Ching (possibly 6th–4th BCE) describes the Tao as the nameless source of all things, best approached through wu wei — effortless action in harmony with nature. Zhuangzi developed this into a playful, relativistic philosophy that celebrates spontaneity and challenges conventional distinctions.
description.ko: 노자의 도덕경은 도를 모든 것의 무명의 근원으로 묘사하며, 자연과의 조화 속에서 무위를 통해 가장 잘 접근할 수 있다고 합니다.

buddhist_philosophy.modern_relevance: Mindfulness-based therapies, consciousness studies, ethics of care

description.en: Buddhist philosophy developed from the Buddha's teaching and expanded through centuries of debate. Key contributions include Nagarjuna's Madhyamaka (all phenomena lack inherent existence) and the Yogacara school's mind-only theory. Buddhist logic and epistemology rivaled Western analytic traditions.
description.ko: 불교 철학은 붓다의 가르침에서 발전하여 수 세기의 논쟁을 통해 확장되었습니다. 주요 공헌으로는 용수의 중관학파(모든 현상은 본질적 존재가 없음)와 유식학파의 유심론이 있습니다.

core_ideas: 'I am because we are' (Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu)
ubuntu_philosophy.modern_relevance: Restorative justice, post-conflict reconciliation, community-centered design

description.en: Ubuntu is a Nguni Bantu philosophy translated as 'I am because we are.' It emphasizes communal bonds, shared humanity, and collective well-being. Archbishop Desmond Tutu popularized it internationally, especially in the context of South Africa's post-apartheid Truth and Reconciliation Commission.
description.ko: '나는 우리가 있기 때문에 존재한다'로 번역되는 응구니 반투 철학입니다. 공동체적 유대, 공유된 인간성, 집단적 복지를 강조합니다. 데스몬드 투투 대주교가 특히 남아프리카의 진실화해위원회 맥락에서 국제적으로 알렸습니다.

core_ideas: Conflict between humans seeking meaning and universe's silence
Reject suicide; reject leap of faith; embrace absurd revolt
Sisyphean struggle as model of authentic living
absurdism.modern_relevance: Mental health, meaning-making, existential crisis response

description.en: Albert Camus (1913–1960) identified the 'absurd' — the clash between our desire for meaning and the universe's silence. Against suicide and religion's 'philosophical leap,' he proposed revolt: living fully despite meaninglessness. 'One must imagine Sisyphus happy.'
description.ko: 알베르 카뮈(1913–1960)는 의미를 향한 우리의 욕구와 우주의 침묵 사이의 충돌인 '부조리'를 규명했습니다. 자살과 종교적 '철학적 도약'에 반대하며, 그는 반항을 제안했습니다: 무의미함에도 불구하고 충만하게 살기.

core_ideas: PERMA model: Positive emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, Achievement
stoic_revival.modern_relevance: Education, coaching, organizational development, mental health

description.en: Founded by Martin Seligman in the late 1990s, positive psychology shifted focus from mental illness to what makes life worth living. The PERMA model identifies five elements of well-being. Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi's concept of 'flow' — optimal engagement — became central to the field.
description.ko: 1990년대 후반 마틴 셀리그먼이 창시한 긍정 심리학은 정신 질환에서 삶을 가치 있게 만드는 것으로 초점을 이동했습니다. PERMA 모델은 웰빙의 다섯 가지 요소를 식별합니다.

famous_quotes: The whole is more than the sum of its parts
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
The more you know, the more you realize you don't know.
The price good men pay for indifference to public affairs is to be ruled by evil men.
At the touch of love, everyone becomes a poet.

core_contributions: Examined life as only life worth living
famous_quotes: The unexamined life is not worth living.
I know that I know nothing.
To find yourself, think for yourself.

key_works: Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals
famous_quotes: Act only according to that maxim by which you can at the same time will that it should become a universal law.
Morality is not the doctrine of how we may make ourselves happy, but how we may make ourselves worthy of happiness.

name.ja: フリードリヒ・ニーチェ

famous_quotes: God is dead. God remains dead. And we have killed him.
That which does not kill us, makes us stronger.
To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in the suffering.

name.ja: ジャン＝ポール・サルトル

famous_quotes: Existence precedes essence.
Hell is other people.
Man is condemned to be free.
We only become what we are by the radical and deep-seated refusal of that which others have made of us.

name.ja: シモーヌ・ド・ボーヴォワール

core_contributions: 'One is not born, but becomes, a woman'
famous_quotes: One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman.
I am an existentialist who does not subscribe to the view that the individual is fully determined.
One must imagine Sisyphus happy.
In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
Don't walk behind me; I may not lead. Don't walk in front of me; I may not follow. Just walk beside me and be my friend.
Do not impose on others what you yourself do not want.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Real knowledge is to know the extent of one's ignorance.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Knowing others is wisdom; knowing yourself is enlightenment.
When you realize there is nothing lacking, the whole world belongs to you.

name.ja: マルクス・アウレリウス

famous_quotes: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
Freedom is the only worthy goal in life.

name.ja: マルティン・ハイデッガー

famous_quotes: Every man is born as many men and dies as a single one.
Language is the house of being.
The philosophers have only interpreted the world in various ways; the point is to change it.
Workers of the world, unite!
From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.

eudaimonia.definition_en: The highest human good — flourishing or well-being achieved through virtuous activity in accordance with reason
eudaimonia.definition_ko: 이성에 따른 덕스러운 활동을 통해 달성되는 번영 또는 안녕 — 인간의 최고선

categorical_imperative.definition_en: Act only according to that maxim whereby you can at the same time will that it should become a universal law
categorical_imperative.definition_ko: 당신이 동시에 보편적 법칙이 되기를 원할 수 있는 준칙에 따라서만 행동하라
formulations: Humanity Formula (treat as ends, not means)

wu_wei.definition_en: Non-action or effortless action — acting in alignment with the natural flow of the Tao rather than forcing outcomes
wu_wei.definition_ko: 무위(無爲) — 결과를 강요하는 것이 아니라 도(道)의 자연스러운 흐름과 조화를 이루며 행동하는 것
wu_wei.modern_equivalent: Flow state, effortless action, systems thinking

sunyata.definition_en: All phenomena lack inherent, independent existence — they arise in dependence upon conditions
sunyata.definition_ko: 모든 현상은 본질적이고 독립적인 존재가 없으며 — 조건에 의존하여 발생한다

absurdity.definition_en: The conflict between humanity's tendency to seek meaning, purpose, and clarity and the silent, indifferent universe that provides none
absurdity.definition_ko: 의미, 목적, 명확성을 추구하는 인간의 경향과 아무것도 제공하지 않는 침묵하고 무관심한 우주 사이의 충돌

logos.definition_en: The rational principle governing the cosmos; divine reason pervading and governing all things
logos.definition_ko: 우주를 지배하는 이성적 원리; 모든 것에 침투하고 지배하는 신성한 이성

dialectic.definition_en: A method of argument through dialogue — thesis, antithesis, synthesis — used to arrive at truth by examining contradictions
dialectic.definition_ko: 대화를 통한 논증 방법 — 정립, 반정립, 종합 — 모순을 검토하여 진리에 도달하는 방법

ren.definition_en: Benevolence, humaneness, love — the central virtue in Confucianism; loving others as an extension of self-cultivation
ren.definition_ko: 인자함, 인간성, 사랑 — 유교의 중심 덕목; 자기 수양의 연장으로서 타인을 사랑하는 것
